verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
We bow before the throne of grace again
Come reveal Yourself to us
All that matters is that You are pleased
With the song that we lift up

verse.name: p1
verse.lines:
With hearts wide open we sing a song to You
And with expectation we ask in faith

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
Draw near to us, O God, as we draw near
As we come close to Your heart

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
You’re our deepest heart’s desire
Come and meet us where we are
Find here that which You are drawn to
A broken and a contrite heart

verse.name: b1
verse.lines:
We came here to meet with You
We won’t leave until we do

verse.name: b2
verse.lines:
We climb this mountain
To pull back the curtain
We’re desperately crying
Show us Your glory

verse.name: o1a
verse.lines:
I lift my eyes up to the hill
Where does my help come from
It comes from You and You alone

verse.name: o2a
verse.lines:
Our God reigns forever and ever
Our God reigns forever and ever

verse.name: o1b
verse.lines:
We want to see
We want to see
Lord, give us eye salve

verse.name: o2b
verse.lines:
Son of David, have mercy
Open my eyes so I can see
